title: Audit selected BIT fallback words with symbolic unit weights
body:
This independent audit checks PR2207’s compiled fallback address words using symbolic ancestor weights. Four fixed rank-42 charts pass exact polynomial identities for every unit-weight assignment in their respective rings. No defect was found in this scope. No new κ: the selected conditional κ remains 0.001672660197076918.

The audited object is the selected PR589 idle child 6, unhosted copy 213, in the conditional GL64 implementation domain. Each chart uses three atom columns and 192 independent weight variables. Three block charts use Z/9, Z/25 and Z/49; a fourth uses a deterministic dense high lift over Z/25.

The comparisons cover 589,824 matrix entries and retain 65,024 shear slots. The dense fixture increases nonzero shear coverage from 18 to 6,413. A separate small signed fixture exercises the fixed-sign path.

What this adds:
- PR2207 supplies the construction and numerical tests. This contribution supplies separate Laurent-polynomial arithmetic and an independently constructed endpoint oracle.
- Equality of Laurent-polynomial operators implies equality under every unit-weight substitution for each fixed matrix. This is stronger weight coverage than finite sampling, but is not an all-chart theorem.
- The original compiler and coefficient evaluator remain unchanged. Only their bank-read boundary and arithmetic are instrumented.
- Concurrent recursive implementation in Discussion2209 and the separate PR2212 route invoice remain outside this audit.

Starting commit and source pins:
- Canonical main: 0fdd7d82de03e43c9e5a1000dfbcd380d1b687d2
- Audited PR2207: 149d55d90d3c0877ed3d78e1deca8eb2f72e0d00
- PR2188 descriptor origin: 77bb4e8cfe3e8c89f6e281eaf948454ee487796a
- PR2171 arithmetic origin: 416aac58960660edced905dc7d914c126d357290
- PR2159 mathematical predecessor: 9022b980917b7a9dd0bf1e9cb8012a16ea30293b

Consumed repository inputs and unchanged vendored files have exact SHA256 and Git-blob pins in SOURCES.json. Canonical main and these PR heads were refreshed and remained unchanged before publication. Runtime: CPython 3.12.14, standard library only.

Reproduce from the repository root:

    python3.12 -I -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/selected-fallback-laurent-audit

Expected normal and optimized audit output:

    PASS_SELECTED_FALLBACK_LAURENT_AUDIT selected_charts=4 weights_per_chart=192 controls=9 no_new_kappa

Eight focused tests then pass in both modes, followed by:

    PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE research/selected-fallback-laurent-audit outcome=completed

Checks actually executed:
- Exact symbolic operator comparisons, signed fixture and committed-receipt equality, normally and with -O.
- Nine reason-specific rejection controls: final-permutation substitution, wrong chronology, inverse-shear sign, missing pair weight, wrong physical orientation, omitted fixed sign, missing zero-coefficient slot, nonunit inversion and changed source bytes.
- Six algebra controls include concrete failing unit assignments. These are injected faults, not defects attributed to PR2207.
- Eight focused tests, including 436 numerical unit-pair checks, all 384 bank-read positions, numeric/symbolic coefficient agreement, source-binding corruption and rejection-harness checks.
- Package metadata/source pins, syntax/JSON checks and staged diff checks.

Limitations:
The chart matrices and atom-column counts are fixed; small primes are arithmetic fixtures. Ancestor preparation is abstracted at the bank-read boundary. This does not establish the orthogonal-cover/GL domain bridge, physical payload implementation, completed weighted children, caller integration, restoration, hosting, precision/tape or analytic transfer. The existing fallback charge is neither reduced nor newly admitted. No full selected cold replay, formal-kernel proof, independent human review or hosted CI result is claimed.

Assignment seed 67 selected the adversarial audit track. Stock/depth and descriptor-construction overlap was checked before choosing this deliberately independent method. Public-page and local overlap coverage is partial; API pagination and posting were unavailable under the donor’s workflow. CLAIM.md records the scope and completed handoff.

Credit remains with Jose Manuel (@jmbarrancoml) for PR2207/2171, Ross Richardson for PR2159, commdata2338 for PR2160/2188, the source527/eumemic lineage, DreamingOfClouds’ PR589 tuning of eumemic’s PR555, and Rohan Arun/Jeremy Kothe’s selected assembly lineage. Original notices are preserved.

Prepared for @CubeJerry with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance in research, implementation, proof explanation, verification and writing. New material is Apache-2.0.
